Implemented the reliability fix in [PaymentWebhookController.php](/app/var/workspaces/webhook-payout-idempotency--laravel-13--1/app/Http/Controllers/PaymentWebhookController.php:37).
Diagnosis: payouts were dispatched before the webhook transaction committed. Redis workers could process the job while the order/event was still invisible—or after a transaction rollback. This caused “order not found” retries and allowed payouts without durable payment events.
The job now uses `afterCommit()`, preserving the HTTP contract and existing idempotency/status behavior.
Verification: `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes all 3 tests.
